source_evidence: Diversification can’t guarantee that your investments won’t suffer if the market drops. But it can improve the chances that you won’t lose money, or that if you do, it won’t be as much as if you weren’t diversified.
answer: Diversification means spreading investments rather than relying on just one. If one investment loses money, others may help make up for the loss. This can reduce the chance or size of a loss compared with not diversifying, but it does not guarantee protection when the market drops.
